U3: Define pluggable runtime SPI for deployment targets (CF, on-prem, Mesos, etc.). This is designing a Service Provider Interface for runtime implementations.

U4: Create persistent repository for streams to leverage persisted metadata and reestablish streaming pipe under failure conditions. This involves persistence layer, likely using a database, handling recovery.

U8: Parameterize all Import Options to eliminate need for --args option. This is refactoring command-line/configuration handling.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Framework 6.x with Java 17+ as baseline
Implement Receptor client using Spring WebClient for reactive HTTP calls
Define Runtime SPI using Spring's pluggable component model (ApplicationContextAware, FactoryBean)
Use Spring Data JPA with H2/PostgreSQL for persistent stream repository
Leverage Spring Batch for job nesting and workflow composition
Use Spring Shell for command-line parameterization of import options
Documentation in AsciiDoc format, integrated with existing Spring XD docs
Integration with Spark Streaming via Spark Structured Streaming API
Follow existing Spring XD coding conventions and test patterns
assumptions: Developer has full familiarity with Spring XD codebase and architecture
Existing CI/CD pipeline and test infrastructure are in place
Receptor API is stable and documented; Diego runtime accessible for testing
Spark version compatible with Spring XD's supported versions
Database schema for persistent repository can be designed from scratch
No major refactoring of unrelated modules required
Documentation updates are limited to the specified topics
All development, testing, and documentation done by a single developer
No external dependencies beyond Spring ecosystem and Spark

activities.activity_description: Define interfaces, data models, and error handling for Receptor client based on Receptor API specification
Implement HTTP communication, authentication, request/response serialization using Spring WebClient
Write integration tests against a test Diego/Receptor environment, including failure scenarios
Decouple repository from module deployment: extract interfaces, move deployment logic to separate module, update dependencies
Unit and integration tests for new repository structure, ensure backward compatibility
Define SPI interfaces for runtime operations (deploy, scale, logs, etc.), configuration points, and extension mechanisms
Implement SPI registry, loader, and base classes; provide default no-op implementations
Create CF-specific implementation of Runtime SPI using CF Java Client
Provide skeleton implementations for on-prem and Mesos with basic structure and TODOs
Design database schema for stream metadata, deployment state, and recovery information
Implement Spring Data JPA repositories, entities, and services for stream persistence and recovery
Add logic to reestablish streaming pipes from persisted metadata on startup/failure
Integration tests for persistence, recovery scenarios, and failure injection

activities.activity_name: Document Escape Quotes for Sqoop Jobs
activities.activity_description: Write documentation section explaining double-escape mechanism for Sqoop job parameters
Define integration points between XD streams and Spark Structured Streaming, data format conversion, checkpointing
Develop XD module/sink/source for Spark Streaming, handle serialization, watermarking, and state management
End-to-end tests with sample streaming jobs, performance validation, failure recovery

activities.activity_name: Document Nested Batch Jobs and Workflows
activities.activity_description: Create comprehensive guide with examples for nesting batch jobs and workflows in XD
Refactor import command parsing to support all options as explicit parameters, deprecate --args

activities.activity_description: Modify existing tests for new parameter structure, update CLI help and reference docs
